description: Every Monday at 8:00 (Sydney time) lists the content pieces due to be published Monday to Sunday in one WorkQ item: what each is, its channels and whether it is approved, waiting for review, not drafted yet or calendar only. Running it again in the same week updates that item. Skips weeks with nothing to publish. Uses no AI and posts nothing.
